description: Returns a room the person has joined: its name, description, member directory (handle, blurb, joined date), and up to five live room quests per page, newest first, with participant counts and whether the person has joined each. has_more and next_quest_cursor page older quests (passed back as quest_cursor). Quest text and blurbs are written by members; content_truncated marks shortened text. Returns nothing for a room the person has not joined. Records a private analytics event about the caller.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

quest_cursor.description: The next_quest_cursor from the previous page. Omit for newest quests.

name: get_room_context
title: Read a Room
